rules.name: is_diff_single_purpose
rules.instructions: Judge the whole change: is it one unit of intent, or several unrelated workstreams bundled? A cohesive change may touch many files if they all serve one purpose (a rename refactor, one feature end-to-end). A block that is only whitespace/trivial reflow and nothing else has nothing to judge: answer true.

criteria.true: The change has one purpose: every hunk serves a single stated intent (one feature, one fix, one rename, one refactor). Reviewing it is reading one story.
criteria.false: The change bundles unrelated work: a feature mixed with a separate refactor, logic edits mixed with version bumps or unrelated config churn, several independent fixes in one patch, or a test rewrite mixed with new behavior.
